# Fermi_Surface_Reconstruction

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The modification of the Fermi surface topology due to strong correlations or symmetry breaking, often accompanying pseudogap formation. Directly influences transport and topological properties, which are key for designing reconfigurable interconnects in TCC systems.
